import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
/**
 * 仇人列表
 * 指令：/仇人
 *
 * 展示最近7天打劫过自己的玩家列表，支持一键回击/打劫
 */

import App from '@src/response-apps/enemy/app';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { createQuoteMarkdown, FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';
import dayjs from 'dayjs';
export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const uid = e.uid as number;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;

  const result = await App({ bid, uid });

  const md = Format.createMarkdown();

  if (result.code === 'EMPTY') {
    md.addText('最近7天无人打劫你，天下太平。');

    void message.send(
      FormatGui({
        isPrivate,
        bid,
        title: '仇人',
        content: md,
        footer: [
          { label: '打劫记录', command: '/打劫记录' },
        ]
      })
    );

    return;
  }

  const { enemies } = result.data;

  for (let i = 0; i < enemies.length; i++) {
    const enemy = enemies[i];
    const timeAgo = dayjs(enemy.lastAttackTime).format('MM-DD HH:mm');

    md.addBlockquote(
      createQuoteMarkdown(
        [`【${i + 1}】${enemy.name}`, `打劫${enemy.totalAttacks}次 最近${timeAgo}`],
        [
          { label: '回击', command: `/回击 ${enemy.lastLogId}` },
          { label: '打劫', command: `/打劫 ${enemy.uid}` }
        ]
      )
    );
  }

  void message.send(
    FormatGui({
      isPrivate,
      bid,
      title: `近7日共 ${enemies.length} 位仇人`,
      content: md,
      footer: [
        { label: '打劫记录', command: '/打劫记录' },
      ]
    })
  );
});
